anomalies.observed: U4 pin 9 (VDD) is connected only to C7, which goes to GND; there is no connection from U4 pin 9 to the VCC net. The VCC net connects to U4 pin 28 (VCC) instead.
anomalies.expected: U4 VDD (logic supply) should be tied to VCC and decoupled by C7 to GND, as the spec states C7 is on U4 VCC (digital-logic supply pin).

evidence.quote: Display sheet: C7 2.2u is connected between U4 pin 9 (VDD) and GND; VCC symbol connects to U4 pin 28 (VCC), with no junction to pin 9.
C7 (2.2 µF) — U4 VCC (digital-logic supply pin) to GND

anomalies.impact: The display's logic supply pin is unpowered, so the OLED display will not operate.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains an open connection on the display sheet: U4 pin 9 (VDD) is only connected to C7 and GND, not to VCC, leaving the display logic supply unpowered. This contradicts the specification that C7 is on U4 VCC (digital-logic supply pin).
